name: Tooltip
title: Components/Overlays/Tooltip
description: Explain a compact control without adding permanent visual noise.
purpose: Explain a compact control without adding permanent visual noise.
usage: Use short supporting text; important instructions belong in visible content. RichTooltip adds a title, description, and optional shortcut.
